It's not right for any staff member to force a customer to make a purchase, especially after a customer has changed their mind about buying a product. Customer service should always be courteous and respectful.

It's concerning that you felt threatened by the staff member's insistence on making a purchase or facing police involvement. Customers should never feel pressured or coerced into buying something they don't want. It's important for the staff to understand and respect the customer's decisions and choices.

I recommend reaching out to Dmart's customer service or management team to share your experience. Providing feedback can help them address issues with staff training and customer service practices. Every customer should feel valued and respected during their shopping experience.

I hope your next visit to( soloists building new on eastern exp hwy opp sudha park kamraj Nagar ghatkopar east mumbai 400077), will be a more positive and enjoyable one. If you have any further concerns or feedback, don't hesitate to communicate with Dmart's management for a resolution.

featured_reviews.name: Manoj Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Pantnagar Bhaji Market in Ghatkopar East, Mumbai, is a bustling hub for fresh, affordable produce, offering a wide variety of vegetables and fruits. Known for competitive, non-fixed pricing, it’s a favorite for daily household needs and bulk orders, ideally visited early morning for the best quality.

Located in the heart of Pant Nagar, this market is more than just a place to shop; it is an experience of local Mumbai culture. Residents and visitors alike appreciate the vibrant atmosphere, where numerous vendors sell everything from everyday staples like potatoes and onions to seasonal greens and exotic fruits. The market is highly regarded for offering fresh, high-quality vegetables at reasonable rates compared to local supermarkets.

Pros of Pantnagar Bhaji Market:

Variety and Freshness: A vast selection of fresh, leafy vegetables, staples, and fruits are available daily.

Budget-Friendly: Prices are competitive, making it ideal for daily shopping.

Accessibility: Situated in a well-connected locality, it is easily reachable for residents of Ghatkopar East.

Bulk Ordering: Many vendors are accommodating and can handle bulk orders for parties or community events.

Tips for a Better Experience:

Time Your Visit: While the market is active throughout the day, visiting early in the morning (around 7 AM to 9 AM) ensures you get the freshest stock.

Handling Crowds: It can get crowded, especially during peak evening hours or weekends, so be prepared for a lively atmosphere.

In summary, for residents seeking fresh, affordable produce in Ghatkopar East, the Pantnagar Bhaji Market is a go-to destination, offering a traditional, lively, and cost-effective shopping experience.

featured_reviews.name: Reshma Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at Reliance Mart, Mumbai Central. The store was poorly maintained, the floors were dirty, and overall cleanliness was far below expected standards. Staff behavior was unprofessional and lacked basic courtesy. There was no proper coordination among employees, making the shopping experience frustrating.

The worst part was at the billing counter. After standing in line for nearly 15 minutes, I was informed that only cash payments were being accepted and that card payments were unavailable. Customers should be informed about such issues before they spend time shopping and waiting in long queues. This caused unnecessary inconvenience and wasted time.

Management seriously needs to improve cleanliness, staff behavior, communication, and payment facilities. Overall, a very poor shopping experience that did not meet basic customer service expectations.

featured_reviews.name: Vinicius Seixo de Brito
featured_reviews.review_text: I was finding everything very good until I saw a huge RAT running under the shelves on both days I was there. The staff treated me very well, the variety of products is excellent, and the prices are good, but a RAT? That's the height of lack of hygiene. It's dangerous, it transmits diseases.

featured_reviews.name: Barbeque nation
featured_reviews.review_text: Place is so Good and always clean... But the staff Group behaviour and the way they talk is not good. But they are experienced and always ready to help. Reliance Smart is really so good, they just need to focus on their Staff groups. There is one more not looking good and that's Billing counter, Please setup more billing counters with some extra space for Coustomer Queue

featured_reviews.name: Danish Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Reliance Smart is a convenient one-stop supermarket for daily groceries and household essentials. You can find a wide variety of products like fruits, vegetables, packaged food, dairy items, and personal care products all in one place, which makes shopping easy and time-saving. 🛒  
India
The store is usually well-organized, and there are frequent discounts and offers, which help save money on regular purchases. 🏷️
However, during peak hours it can get quite crowded, and billing counters may take some time. Also, product availability can sometimes be inconsistent.
Overall, it’s a good place for regular shopping needs, especially if you are looking for affordable prices and variety. 👍

featured_reviews.name: Abhi Dabholkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at Reliance Smart was completely unacceptable and highly unprofessional.
The store officially closes at 11:00 PM. We entered at around 10:10 PM, which is well within the permitted shopping time. Despite this, a staff member approached us at approximately 10:15 PM and aggressively insisted that we stop shopping and proceed to billing immediately.
To make matters worse, the staff deliberately switched off the lights in the section where we were selecting items—clearly an attempt to force us out. This kind of behavior is not only rude but also humiliating for customers.
This reflects extremely poor management, lack of basic customer service ethics, and zero respect for customers’ time. If the store intends to stop allowing customers before closing time, it should clearly communicate accurate timings instead of misleading people.
Such disgraceful conduct from staff at a reputed brand like Reliance is shocking. Immediate action, strict staff training, and accountability are required.
strongly discourage others from visiting this outlet if this is the level of service being provided. Completely unacceptable.

customer_updates.name: Evilfox GamerZ
customer_updates.text:
I recently visited [Nature's Basket ] and was impressed by the quality and variety of products available. The selection of fresh fruits and vegetables is outstanding, with everything looking vibrant and well-stocked. It’s clear that the store prioritizes quality and freshness, which makes shopping there a pleasure.

The grocery section is equally impressive, offering a wide range of products that cater to different tastes and preferences. The shelves are neatly organized, making it easy to find what you need. The staff is friendly and helpful, always ready to assist with any inquiries or recommendations.

Overall, Natuer's Basket provides an excellent shopping experience with its focus on fresh produce and quality groceries. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and well-stocked supermarket. Keep up the great work!

featured_reviews.name: jasmine L
featured_reviews.review_text:
BUYERS BEWARE !
Visited Stores on 27th. There was just no staff in the Stores, as all were busy with packing Hampers.
Purchased some Royal Gala Apples and some Kinnaur Apples from Himachal Pradesh.
Before packing,  enquired from the Staff the price of Kinnaur Apples and informed that they are Rs 299. Considering the Quality it was okay as normal price is around Rs  250.
Each Apple has a Label of Kinnaur Apples but the Price Tags on the Brown Paper Bag shows purchase of Apple Royal Gala and Billed at Rs 449.
For the Royal Gala that we purchased the Label shows Apple Red Delicious Washington.
Interaction with the Staff with Photos with Copy of the Bill did not fetch any Results
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
"Hi Jasmine, 
Thank you for connecting with us. Please DM us your invoice details or contact details, as our team would like to connect with you to understand your feedback better and do what is needed."

review_photos.caption: Each Apple has Kinnaur Apple Label but the Price Tag is Apple Royal Gala.
Purchased Royal Gala but Price Tag shows Apple Red Delicious Washington

featured_reviews.name: imran badami
featured_reviews.review_text:
Was reliving my college days at churchgate and decide to hydrate myself with a posh drink.

Stepped inside Nature Basket and found of variety of canned - juices, coffee and aerated drinks.

The options unlimited, made it difficult for me to choose so i bottomed down to a basic sprite can.

The staff were courteous and helpful even when they knew i was not going to buy a lot.

At natures basket u can keep all your cans in one basket.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
"Hi Imran, 
We really appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback and hope you will continue visiting Nature’s Basket. Thanks again!"

featured_reviews.name: Jhalak Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I bought 2 packets of baby carrot of tirkaya brand. On the tirkaya website the price is Rs. 40 per packet and at natures basket they sold it to me at Rs. 89 per packet.

This is more than double which is ridiculous. I needed it urgently and thats why i bought it or else would have definitely ordered from their website.

Even pricing for othee things is higher than other stores. I had bottle a bottle of gerkins and then checked the price of the same bottle at another store there was a difference of Rs. 35 on that and then i felt that Nature's basket should be a store for emergencies rather than buying daily groceries for me !!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
"Hi Jhalak, 
Thank you for connecting with us & sorry for the inconvenience caused. Please DM us your invoice/contact details, as our team would like to connect with you to understand the details & investigate this further. Kindly feel free to reach out to us on cs@naturesbasket.co.in or call on 8880077745"
